VA – Mad Powers (2025)

VA – Mad Powers features 16 new psychedelic tracks compiled by aGh0Ri TanTriK. We are excited to have this as our second power compilation for 2025!

Mad Powers delivers rocking charges to your shape-ships. Mapping new pathways and dimensions, hacking through the demented sections, creating new darkness and evil.
